premise: As the sun sets and night comes, the quietest friends of the rock pool get ready for sleep: Urchin wiggles, Clam closes up, and Seaweed leans over them like a blanket.
inspiration: The bedtime round of nursery rhyme (goodnight to each one in turn), set in a rock pool, ending under a soft green blanket.

en-US.title: The Quietest Friends
en-US.text: {canvas:sunset 0.8 25s} [softly] The sun was going down over the rock pool, gold and pink. {urchin:enter} {urchin:go to pool} Urchin yawned a little purple yawn. {urchin:face happy} {urchin:live wiggle} He wiggled his soft spines, one last wiggle. {clam:enter} [whispers] Goodnight, Urchin, said Clam. {clam:face happy} {clam:live peek} She opened up wide, showed her pearl to the evening sky, and closed again, snug and tight. {seaweed:enter} Seaweed swayed, slow… slow… {seaweed:face sleeping} [short pause] {canvas:night 0.8 40s} Night came softly. The moon looked down into the water. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Starfish waved one sleepy arm. {starfish:live wave} Goodnight, everyone. {urchin:live sleep hold} Urchin closed his eyes. {clam:face sleeping} Clam closed hers. {seaweed:live sway hold} And Seaweed leaned over her quiet little friends, gentle as a blanket. [long pause] [whispers] {starfish:face sleeping} Shhh. The rock pool is sleeping. Goodnight.

es-ES.title: Los amigos más callados
es-ES.text: {canvas:sunset 0.8 25s} [softly] El sol se escondía sobre la charca, dorado y rosa. {urchin:enter} {urchin:go to pool} Erizo bostezó un bostezo pequeñito y morado. {urchin:face happy} {urchin:live wiggle} Meneó sus pinchos suaves, un último meneo. {clam:enter} [whispers] Buenas noches, Erizo, dijo Almeja. {clam:face happy} {clam:live peek} Se abrió de par en par, enseñó su perla al cielo de la tarde, y se volvió a cerrar, bien calentita. {seaweed:enter} Alga se mecía, despacio… despacio… {seaweed:face sleeping} [short pause] {canvas:night 0.8 40s} La noche llegó despacito. La luna se asomó al agua. {starfish:enter} {starfish:go to pool} Estrella movió un brazo dormilón. {starfish:live wave} Buenas noches a todos. {urchin:live sleep hold} Erizo cerró los ojos. {clam:face sleeping} Almeja cerró los suyos. {seaweed:live sway hold} Y Alga se inclinó sobre sus amigos callados, suave como una manta. [long pause] [whispers] {starfish:face sleeping} Chist. La charca está dormida. Buenas noches.
